decodedFrameGeometry: 64x36 grayscale, bilinear, original image extent (ignore output even-dimension padding)
audioMethod: independent full-source stereo decode at 48000Hz, average channels and six samples to 8000Hz; normalized cross-correlation of output at head, middle and tail within +/-80ms of expected source position
silentWindowPolicy: report inconclusive; never claim audio alignment verified on silence
limitation: Separate verification implementation shares FFmpeg decoder with export; this verifies preservation of source A/V timing, not whether the original itself was synchronized.
